You said I should visit often if I wanted to earn your trust.
strings.네, 제가 분명 그렇게 말했었죠. 어떤 이야기를 해야 할까요? 역시 당신: Yes, I did. What shall we discuss? Naturally, what you seek.
The power needed for Goddess Iris to become the world's true master...
strings.저는 이리스를 위해 메디아 님이 가진 힘의 흔적을 받아야 해요. 초인의: For Iris's sake, I need a trace of your power. The Champions' strength helps her...
strings.일개 인간일 뿐인 저의 힘이 여신에게 도움이 된다는 것이 이상하지 않나요: Doesn't it seem strange that the power of a mere human like me would help a goddess? Human and divine power are different.
Yet the goddess receives it and immediately gains another ability...
strings.생각해보니 뭔가 살짝 이상한 것 같기도 해요. 초인의 힘을 저를 통해 이: Now that you mention it, it does seem a little strange. Even if she receives a Champion's power through me...
strings.초인도 인간이고, 저도 인간인데…, 이리스는 신의 영역에 있고. 으, 복: Champions are human, and so am I... But Iris is in the realm of gods. Ugh, it's complicated.
strings.의문스러운 부분이 많았을 텐데, 당신은 이리스 여신님에 대해선 하나도 그: There must have been many things to question, yet you harbor no doubts about Goddess Iris.
strings.미묘하지만 부러운 관계네요. 그럼 본론으로 들어갈까요?: A subtle relationship, but an enviable one. Shall we get to the point?
strings.최종적으로는 데이모스 교단이 저희 일족을 사냥해 얻은 힘으로 만들어진 마: Ultimately, stones made by the Deimos cult from the power gained by hunting our people.
strings.아발론에 가지 않는 이상 구할 수는 없을 거예요. 그리고 간다고 해도 어: You won't find those without going to Avalon. Even there, you wouldn't know where to look...
strings.단지 그들의 마석이 얼마 남지 않은 것 같다 짐작하는 정도군요. 교단에서: I can only guess they're running low. Their incursions into Adrica have become more frequent...
That's why you hid the village. To protect it...
strings.저희는 오랫동안 그렇게 살아왔으니까요. 그래서 마석을 통해 그들이 집착하: We've lived that way for a long time. I want to use the stones to learn what they are so obsessed with.
strings.그래서 마석의 흔적이 있었던 곳에서 가져다 주셨으면 합니다. 필요한 마석: Bring stones from places where their traces were found: a 'Stone of Greed,' a 'Powerful Brainwashing Stone,' and a 'Stone of Disillusionment.'
Magic stones found in Jiendia, Freios, and Eastland...
strings.아, 바로 구해서 드릴게요. 그래서 말이죠…. 이 일이 끝나면 저는 메디: I'll get them. But... When this is done, will I have earned your trust?
I'll consider you more favorably than before.
strings.네, 필요하시다니 구해다 드릴게요. 저도 다른 단서가 있나 찾아봐야겠어요: All right. If you need them, I'll bring them. I'll look for other clues, too. I'll be back.
I brought the stones you asked for. Here...
strings.잠깐 여기서 기다리시겠어요?: Would you wait here a moment?
I'll serve tea so you won't be bored while waiting.
strings.향이 좋은데, 이 차의 이름을 알 수 있을까요?: It smells lovely. What's it called?
strings.다프네라고 환영의 대지에만 자라는 나무가 있는데, 그 잎으로 우린 차입니: It's brewed from the leaves of a tree called daphne, found only in the Land of Illusions. Daphne was also the name of our previous leader, who was like a mother to me.
strings.전 훌륭하신 분으로 기억하는데, 어떤 이의 남겨진 기억엔 발푸르기스의 밤: I remember her as a wonderful person. Yet in someone's lingering memories, she's called a witch who reveled in Walpurgis Night...
strings.이런 이야기까지 하게 되는군요. 못 들은 걸로 하세요. 정말, 당신이란: To think I'd tell you even that. Pretend you didn't hear it. You truly are a strange person...
strings.(판도라가 이건 관여하지 말라고 했었지….): (Pandora told me not to get involved in that...)
It wasn't difficult to identify the traits of the stones you brought.
strings.세개 중 하나, 초인 기념관에서 발견된 건 데이모스 교단이 만든 것 같: One of the three, from the Hall of Heroes, seems to be the Deimos cult's work. It held a faint trace of our people's life force.
What on earth is the cult trying to do...?
We've investigated for over two hundred years, but no one has found the answer.
strings.그럼 다른 두개의 마석에 대해 이야기해보죠. 분명 아가슈라라고 불리는 자: Now, the other two. They clearly bear traces of those called Agasuras, but...
strings.왜 그러시죠? 무슨 문제라도 있나요?: What's wrong? Is there a problem?
strings.아무래도 데이모스 교단의 마석을 흉내낸 모조품입니다. 실력은 있지만, 원: They're imitations of the cult's stones. Skillfully made, but far short of the originals.
strings.샤이닉 님이 반과 마라를 가짜 아가슈라라고 했는데, 그것과 상관있나요?: Shynic called Ban and Mara false Agasuras. Is that related?
I've rarely encountered Agasuras. I can't answer that.
Imitations, yet they devastated Jiendia and Freios... Then the cult's stones are even more dangerous...
...That's all I have to say. Thank you.
strings.(뭔가 더 알고 있는 것 같은데, 여기서 잘라버리다니….): (She seems to know more, but she's cutting me off...)
strings.그리고 레이어의 부탁으로 구해주신 책에 대해선 감사했습니다. 짧게나마 여: And thank you for the book you obtained at Layer's request. It let me briefly understand the goddess's feelings.
strings.그 책을 읽어보셨군요. 어, 그런데 누가 가져다 준거죠?: You read it? Who brought it to you?
strings.타르타로스에서 교류를 원해 물건을 잔뜩 보내왔더군요. 베이넌이 돌려보내자: Tartaros sent a large shipment, seeking renewed relations. Beinan wanted to send it back, but I couldn't bring myself to refuse, so I accepted it for now.
strings.돌아가시는 길이라면 힘써준 레이어에게 안부를 전해주세요. 저는 잘 있다고: If you're returning, give my regards to Layer for his efforts. Tell him I'm well, and that his choice was right.
And give Noel a message, too.
strings.데이모스 교단 때문에 위험할 수 있으니 지스카드가 있는 루맨과 샤이닉이: Because of the danger from the Deimos cult, she should stay within Lumen, where Ziskad is, and Tartaros, where Shynic is...
I'll tell them everything. See you again.
strings.(어쩌면 한 번 더 오셔야 될지도 모르겠군요….): (Perhaps you'll need to visit once more...)
strings.피곤해 보이네, 자기. 매우 바쁜가 봐. 어디서 오는 길이야?: You look tired. Keeping busy? Where have you come from?
strings.맞다. 자기는 보통 사람이 아니었지. 쉽게 찾을 수 없는 마을 '칼리'를: Of course. You're no ordinary person. Finding the elusive village of Kali... Just what I'd expect of the goddess's chosen.
Medea asked me to give you her regards.
That she's well, and your choice was right.
strings.30년 전, 메디아 님을 만나기 전 나는 엄청난 분노를 품고 있었어. 모: Thirty years ago, before I met Medea, I was consumed by anger. If I couldn't kill everyone, I wanted to kill at least one person...
strings.그래서 일을 끝내고 쥬드 왕국으로 돌아가던 중이었고, 저번에 이야기했던: I was returning to Jude after a job. Then, as I told you before, I ended up in Kali.
strings.뭐, 그곳에서 짧은 시간 동안 지내면서 메디아 님 덕분에 생각을 고쳐 먹: During my brief stay, Medea helped me change my mind.
I won't tell you whom I wanted to kill, so don't pry. Hahaha.
strings.(레이어가 말이 끝나기 무섭게 창고에서 당근을 하나 꺼내 흔들기 시작한다: (As soon as he finishes speaking, Layer takes a carrot from the warehouse and starts waving it.)
strings.저기, 레이어. 갑자기 당근을 왜 흔드시는 거죠?: Layer, why are you suddenly waving a carrot?
...Oh, you noticed. Should I explain or not...?
strings.에이, 모르겠다. 누가 칼리에 다녀온 이야기를 한다면 노엘이 조용히 당근: Ah, whatever. Noel told me that if anyone mentioned visiting Kali, I should discreetly wave a carrot. She must have needed time to prepare.
I was supposed to be subtle. Apparently, I made it too obvious. Hahaha.
strings.…그러게요, 너무 잘 보였어요. 안 그래도 메디아 님이 노엘에게도 전해달: ...Yes, very obvious. Medea has a message for Noel, too.
strings.잘됐네. 노엘도 기다리고 있을 거야. 아, 내가 다음에 내가 한 턱 쏠: Good. Noel will be waiting. Oh, I'll treat you next time. Look forward to it.
Great! Let me know when. I'll go see Noel now.
Oh, right. What a wonderful adventurer! Won't you buy something?
strings.아, 아니에요!! 저는 물건을 팔고 있었답니다!: I mean, no! I was selling my wares!
strings.후우…, 맞아요. 칼리에 다녀온 사람의 이야기를 듣게 된다면 당근을 흔들: Sigh... Yes. I asked him to wave a carrot if he heard from someone who'd visited Kali.
Why a carrot? There are other things to wave.
strings.이스트랜드에는 오래전부터 은밀하게 일을 진행하거나 조심스레 확인할 때는: In Eastland, people have apparently waved carrots for secret dealings or discreet checks since long ago.
strings.그래서 모험가님이 칼리에 다녀오신 거 맞죠?: So you really went to Kali?
strings.(메디아가 노엘을 위해 전했던 이야기를 한다.): (You pass along Medea's message for Noel.)
strings.후후, 역시 메디아 님은 걱정이 많으시다니까요. 안 그래도 그러고 있는데: Hehe. She worries so much. I'm already doing that.
strings.모험가님, 제 부탁 하나만 들어주시겠어요? 모험가님은 칼리를 찾아서 바로: Adventurer, could you do me one favor? You can find Kali and enter directly, so you should be able to help.
strings.그게 무슨 말이에요? 마치 노엘이 마을에 들어가지 못한다는 이야기로 들리: What do you mean? It sounds like you can't enter the village...
strings.마을은 메디아 님의 힘으로 보호받고 있어요. 아무리 칼리 족이라도 한 번: Medea's power protects it. Even a Kali who leaves can't easily find it again. I only learned that after leaving.
strings.다시 마을을 찾을 수 없다니…. 게다가 환영의 대지에 있어서 위험하기도: I can't find my way back... And the Land of Illusions is dangerous... But someone special like you can see it clearly.
strings.그래도 다행인 건 말이죠. 데이모스 교단에서 제대로 인식하지 못했다는 거: At least the Deimos cult hasn't properly located it.
strings.무슨 말인지 알았어요. 그래서 제가 뭘 도와드리면 될까요?: I understand. How can I help?
strings.칼리에 메리멜이라고, 어릴 때부터 같이 자란 친구가 있어요. 손재주가 좋: I have a childhood friend in Kali named Merimel. She's clever with her hands and makes all sorts of things.
Oh, Merimel! I know her. She's always hard at work.
strings.여전하네요. 후후. 메리멜은 타르타로스의 샤이닉 님처럼 도시도 만들고 싶: Same as ever. Hehe. She admires Shynic and wants to build a city like Tartaros. I hope she doesn't copy her personality, too...
Shh. Shynic's illusions wander everywhere. If she hears that...
strings.샤이닉 님은 이런 건 재미없어 하시니까 괜찮아요. 어쨌든 메리멜이 오랫동: She finds this sort of thing boring, so it's fine. Anyway, Merimel's been building a machine for ages and still hasn't finished.
I looked into what she needs. A Dwarven Artisan's Bolts and Nuts should do. They just need to be brought to her...
strings.거기다 드워프 장인의 만능도구함이란 것만 있으면 메리멜이 만들지 못하는: And with a Dwarven Artisan's Universal Toolbox, there'd be nothing she couldn't build! She's full of talent, unlike me.
So you want me to get those materials and take them to Merimel.
strings.네! 맞아요! 재료만 메리멜에게 가져다 주신다면!! 앞으로 타르타로스의: Yes! Exactly! Bring her the materials, and you'll be a VIP of Noel Trading, future great merchant of Tartaros.
Trust is everything to the Kali.
strings.드워프라는 종족이 사는 도시에서 구할 수 있는 물건이예요. 아직 그곳까지: You can find them in the dwarves' city. I haven't found the courage to go that far yet. Would you go for me?
strings.(칼리족에게 신뢰가 생명이라…. 어, 저번엔 정령들도 신뢰란 단어를 썼던: (Trust is everything to the Kali... Didn't the spirits talk about trust, too...?)
strings.외지인을 반기지 않는다는 건 잘 알고 있어요. 그래도 부탁을 받아 메리멜: I know outsiders aren't welcome. But someone asked me to bring things you need.
strings.(메리멜에게 드워프 장인의 볼트와 너트, 만능 도구함을 전달한다.): (You give Merimel the Dwarven Artisan's Bolts and Nuts and Universal Toolbox.)
Beinan only ever brings useless things...
strings.(저 멀리 있던 베이넌이 메리멜을 보면서 한숨을 내쉬고 있다.): (In the distance, Beinan looks at Merimel and sighs.)
strings.노엘 보고 싶은데 마을 나가선 다시 돌아오지도 않고…. 나쁜 것, 내가: I miss Noel, but she left and never came back... That awful girl. Doesn't she know how worried I've been?
strings.노엘이 그러는데, 한번 나가면 칼리족이라 하더라도 마을의 위치를 쉽게 찾: Noel says even a Kali can't easily find the village again after leaving.
strings.그래서 노엘이 마을을 나간 후, 돌아오지 못했군요. 저는 노엘이 제 생각: So that's why she couldn't return. I thought she'd simply left without thinking of me... I had no idea.
strings.그런데 베이넌은 데이모스 교단의 사냥꾼들을 처리하기 위해 금방 나갔다 다: But Beinan goes out to deal with Deimos cult hunters and comes right back.
strings.뭐, 베이넌은 마을 사람들하고는 조금 다르니까요. 어릴 적부터 이런저런: Well, he's a little different from the other villagers. Things happened when he was young...
strings.덕분에 마을을 지킬 수 있는 기계들을 만들 수 있을 것 같아요. 메디아: Thanks to this, I should be able to build machines to protect the village. Medea worries and tells me not to overdo it...
strings.저는 제가 할 수 있는 범위 안에서 열심히 물건을 만들 거예요. 마을 사: But I'll work hard within my abilities. For everyone in the village!
strings.(이곳 사람들은 서로를 엄청나게 아끼는구나.): (The people here care so deeply for one another.)
strings.모험가님은 이미 노엘에게 신뢰받으시는 것 같아요. 노엘이 그런 걸 아무에: Noel already seems to trust you. She wouldn't ask just anyone for such a favor...
strings.지금 하고 싶은 말이 있었는데, 잃어버렸어요. 다음에 생각나면 알려드릴게: There was something I wanted to say, but I've forgotten. I'll tell you if I remember.
Thank you, adventurer. I think I can trust you now, too.
strings.나중에 도움이 필요하시다면 말씀해주세요. 제가 할 수 있는 범위 안에서: If you need help later, tell me. I'll do everything I can.
Thank you, Merimel. I'll be going.
strings.(메리멜이 노엘의 부탁으로 받게 된 물건들을 빤히 바라보며 훌쩍인다.): (Merimel gazes at the items Noel arranged for her and sniffles.)
